The menu's auto-retry join loop connects to a host whenever one appears, including after the host has already chopped (MAX_CLIENTS=16). The grove is deterministic (rng.seed=2026), so the late peer builds the same trees with the same ids, but with empty levels[] and felled=false. What follows: (1) A tree felled on the server still stands for B. B's swings resolve on the server, where _strike returns early on t.felled, so nothing happens. (2) On a tree that was notched earlier, the server computes amount from its own depth and sends _tree_cut(h,u,amount). B's apply_cut then adds that amount to an empty or shallower level, so B's ChopModel (depth, progress, CSG wedge, marker NEW/DEEPEN, HUD %) stays out of step with the server for good.
